subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced by himself as the one who picked Ilvara up and used the Eldritch Claw Tattoo to wrap tentacles around her, hauling her forty feet into the air and dropping her after striking her twice in the ribs during the ascent.
source_quote: He had opened this fight by *picking Ilvara up*. Used the Eldritch Claw Tattoo to wrap tentacles around her, hauled her forty feet into the air, hit her twice in the ribs during the ascent, and dropped her.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is described by Zalthir as the one whose face was worn by Zuggtmoy, and who spoke in prophecy about the bride, chaos, and the mayhem to come, with the tone of someone who had already made peace with her fate.
source_quote: Something Zuggtmoy-deep, something that had nothing to do with Ilvara Mizzrym's personal opinion of Zalthir and everything to do with the demon lord wearing her face — *landed*.

subject: cavern
fact: The cavern contains a collapsed bridge, a ruined heart fungus, a poisonous bloom of spores from Ilvara’s detonation, and fungal growth thrown up by Ilvara during the fight.
source_quote: The bridge was rubble. The poisonous bloom was already beginning to thin and drift. She was busy reshaping the battlefield around herself, throwing up fungal growth, buying room she knew she needed.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as having teleported across the battlefield using shadow-step and struck the T'sarran mage once, killing him instantly.
source_quote: He teleported across the battlefield — shadow-step, the distance closing in the space between one breath and the next — and hit the mage once, and that was enough. The man went down.

subject: T'sarran mage
fact: The T'sarran mage fired a lightning bolt into the cavern upon arrival, hitting only open air, and was later killed by Zalthir after being previously damaged by Daz's empowered fireball.
source_quote: He had fired a lightning bolt into the cavern when he arrived — a dramatic entrance, the kind with real commitment — and hit nothing. Just open air and ambition. Daz had already run an empowered fireball through him; the man was singed at the edges and blinking with the stunned expression of someone who had entered this fight expecting an easy kill and received instead a detailed education in why that assumption was wrong.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum delivered a Guiding Bolt that struck Ilvara, causing her body to rupture into a massive toxic bloom of poisonous spores, which filled the cavern and forced others to retreat.
source_quote: The bolt left my hand. It lanced across the cavern floor in a concentrated column of radiant light and found her where she stood. She did not die quietly. She detonated. Her body ruptured outward in a massive toxic bloom — a cloud of poisonous spores billowing through the cavern in every direction...

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin toppled the bridge, sending Ilvara and Zalthir crashing to the cavern floor, and destroyed the heart fungus in one devastating round with Dawnbringer.
source_quote: Thorin had already toppled the bridge, sent both of them crashing to the cavern floor... The fungus, at least, was mine. Clean and total. Dawnbringer lit the thing up from the first swing and it never got a second chance.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz fired an empowered fireball that severely damaged the T'sarran mage before Zalthir delivered the killing blow.
source_quote: Daz had already run an empowered fireball through him; the man was singed at the edges and blinking with the stunned expression of someone who had entered this fight expecting an easy kill and received instead a detailed education in why that assumption was wrong.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree dropped to her knees after Ilvara’s detonation and began murmuring prayers to Lolth, reshaping the event into theology for her goddess.
source_quote: Asha Vandree dropped to her knees and began murmuring prayers, her voice the only sound left — words to Lolth, rising from the wreckage, already reshaping what she'd witnessed into something her goddess could use.

subject: T'sarran warrior
fact: The last T'sarran warrior, after witnessing his mage dead and Ilvara reduced to spores, stepped back toward the tunnels and declared, 'We will meet again. Enjoy your victory for the moment.'
source_quote: The last House T'sarran warrior looked at all of it — his mage dead, his guards incinerated, Ilvara nothing but settling spores and a fading prophecy about a bride — and stepped back toward the tunnels without urgency. 'We will meet again,' he said. 'Enjoy your victory for the moment.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is noted as asking his first real question after the spore cloud thinned: 'about Glabbagool.'
source_quote: My first real question, once the cloud was thin enough to breathe through, was about Glabbagool.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is described as standing in silence after the battle, letting the quiet be quiet, acknowledging victory but uncertain of its cost or consequences.
source_quote: I stood there and let the quiet be quiet. We'd won. I couldn't tell you yet what winning this one cost, or what it opened up ahead of us...

subject: bridge
fact: The bridge was toppled by Thorin and reduced to rubble, causing Ilvara and Zalthir to fall into the cavern below.
source_quote: Thorin had already toppled the bridge, sent both of them crashing to the cavern floor...

subject: heart fungus
fact: The heart fungus was destroyed by Thorin in a single round with Dawnbringer, collapsing into ruin before any other combatant could act.
source_quote: The heart fungus was already a collapsed ruin — Thorin had seen to that in one devastating, almost insulting round...

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as having the Eldritch Claw Tattoo with fifteen feet of reach, yet choosing not to close the distance to Ilvara despite the reach advantage.
source_quote: He had the Eldritch Claw Tattoo — fifteen feet of reach — but the distance between him and Ilvara was not fifteen feet.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is described as still howling and muttering prophecies about vengeance, Zuggtmoy, and the bride even after her body had been destroyed, her voice ragged with desperation.
source_quote: Ilvara was still on the far side of the cavern, still howling, her voice ragged with the particular desperation of someone who has run out of futures but not yet run out of throat. *Vengeance. Zuggtmoy. The bride.* All of it tumbling out between strikes and retreats.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir internally acknowledges the rule that he should not be near Ilvara, and accepts the fear condition as self-administered discipline, even though it humiliates him.
source_quote: *I am supposed to be trying to not be near her. Right.* Not a question. Just the rule, stated plainly, applied against his own interest the way you check a knot even when you know you tied it correctly.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum reflects that Bahamut receives credit for the radiance of his Guiding Bolt, while he receives credit for positioning, and that they understand each other.
source_quote: Bahamut gets the credit for the radiance. I get credit for the positioning. We understand each other, Bahamut and I.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'I'm a monk,' in response to being reminded that his entire contribution to the fight required contact with the thing he was supposed to be destroying.
source_quote: 'I'm a monk.' This came out in response to someone noting — correctly, irritatingly — that his entire contribution to a fight was predicated on being in contact with the thing he was supposed to be destroying.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'I do what I can,' after destroying the heart fungus with Dawnbringer, acknowledging the simplicity of his action despite its effectiveness.
source_quote: I said *I do what I can* because what else do you say when you've just ruined someone's evening in two rounds of radiant damage.

subject: tunnels
fact: The T'sarran warrior retreated toward the tunnels after the battle, indicating the conflict was not fully resolved and future encounters are anticipated.
source_quote: and stepped back toward the tunnels without urgency.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir internally notes, '*We barely knew you, man.*' as a silent reflection on the T'sarran mage's death, without speaking it aloud.
source_quote: *We barely knew you, man.* He didn't say this aloud. Just noted it, and turned toward where the remaining work was being done.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum notes that a threat delivered without heat is more credible than one made in anger, and resolves to find out who the matron mother of House T'sarran is.
source_quote: A threat delivered without heat is always more credible than one made in anger. I'll want to remember that name. The matron mother of House T'sarran would be hearing about this. I believe I should find out who that is before she finds out who we are.

subject: cavern floor
fact: The cavern floor is described as littered with the body of the T'sarran mage, the remnants of Ilvara’s spore bloom, and the collapsed fungus, with Asha Vandree praying nearby.
source_quote: The mage's body settled on the cavern floor. Behind Zalthir, someone — Grygum, probably — was already moving forward. Asha Vandree dropped to her knees and began murmuring prayers...

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*I shall punch the mage.*' without enthusiasm, before teleporting and killing him.
source_quote: *I shall punch the mage.* Zalthir said this without particular enthusiasm.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir observes that the fear cleared at the end of his turn, as promised, and notes this without celebration.
source_quote: The fear cleared at the end of his turn, the way it had been promised to. He noted this without celebration.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum reflects that he had planned extensively for the heart fungus but found himself with nowhere to deploy his preparations when Thorin destroyed it in one round.
source_quote: *Boy, I had so much planned for the fungus.*

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin describes himself as having spent most of the battle running, acknowledging that he was not holding the center but simply picking a direction and going.
source_quote: The real version is that I'm a dwarf with a glowing sword in a sprawling cavern fight and at some point you stop pretending you've got angles on all of it and just pick a direction and go.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as having delivered the entire fight as a series of surgical moves with the emotional register of someone sorting correspondence.
source_quote: Zalthir had been up and down and around, doing what Zalthir does, the entire fight a series of surgical moves delivered with the emotional register of someone sorting correspondence.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is described as having been corrupted by Zuggtmoy for a long time, and that she was no longer being aided by the demon lord but had become Zuggtmoy's work walking in a drow priestess’s bones.
source_quote: She was not being aided by Zuggtmoy anymore. She *was* Zuggtmoy's work, walking around in a drow priestess's bones.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as having hated the frightened condition immediately upon understanding it, because it cannot be argued with.
source_quote: Zalthir understood it immediately — and hated it with the particular hatred reserved for things that cannot be argued with.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is described as being amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama but still choosing to attack them, because Bahamut does not favor spectatorship.
source_quote: I'm amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama, I thought. But I think I'm still going to go ahead and attack them.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*How do I not be frightened?*' because he wanted to know the timeline — one turn — and needed to wait.
source_quote: 'How do I not be frightened?' He had asked, because he wanted to know the timeline. One turn. He just needed to wait one turn.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*not ideal, how big is the cloud, glad I was standing back.*' as his entire reflection on killing Ilvara.
source_quote: *not ideal, how big is the cloud, glad I was standing back.* That is the whole thought.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, '*Boy, I had so much planned for the fungus.*' as a silent reflection on Grygum's and Zalthir's actions while he destroyed the fungus.
source_quote: *Boy, I had so much planned for the fungus.*

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as having accepted the condition of fear as self-administered discipline, and not fought it or looked for angles.
source_quote: He didn't fight the condition. He didn't look for angles. The spirit of it was that he shouldn't close on her, and he knew the spirit of it, and so he didn't. The discipline is self-administered. Always has been.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree is described as praying to Lolth in the aftermath, reshaping the event into theology, and Grygum files this under '*watch this space.*'
source_quote: Whatever theology she was building out of this moment, I filed it under *watch this space.*

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as watching Ilvara from across the cavern and being unable to move toward her, filing it away and waiting.
source_quote: He watched from across the cavern and could not move toward her and filed it away and waited.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, '*Maybe she would be.*' in reference to Asha Vandree’s prayers being answered, acknowledging that he has seen stranger things answered.
source_quote: Maybe she would be. I've seen stranger things answered.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*I think I'm still going to go ahead and attack them.*' after observing the Jorlan-Ilvara drama, indicating his decision to act despite amusement.
source_quote: I'm amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama, I thought. But I think I'm still going to go ahead and attack them.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*Yeah. I mean, how do you slap?*' as an internal response to being reminded that his entire contribution required contact with the thing he was supposed to destroy.
source_quote: *Yeah. I mean, how do you slap?* No answer to that.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as having delivered his actions with the emotional register of someone pushing a chair under a table.
source_quote: He had delivered it with the emotional register of someone pushing a chair under a table.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*Bahamut gets the credit for the radiance. I get credit for the positioning.*' as his personal philosophy on divine intervention and tactical execution.
source_quote: Bahamut gets the credit for the radiance. I get credit for the positioning. We understand each other, Bahamut and I.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as having the Eldritch Claw Tattoo, which has fifteen feet of reach, yet he chooses not to use it to close the distance to Ilvara.
source_quote: He had the Eldritch Claw Tattoo — fifteen feet of reach — but the distance between him and Ilvara was not fifteen feet.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, '*You swing at a bridge long enough, the bridge falls. That's not strategy. That's physics.*' as his reflection on his own action.
source_quote: You swing at a bridge long enough, the bridge falls. That's not strategy. That's physics.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is described as having watched Ilvara’s final moments, respecting her discipline of speaking prophecy rather than begging.
source_quote: She wasn't going to beg. He could respect the discipline of that, abstractly.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*I took mental notes. It's what I do.*' as his explanation for observing the Jorlan-Ilvara drama.
source_quote: I took mental notes. It's what I do.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, '*I felt a little bad, in the way you feel bad about something you'd do exactly the same way again.*' after destroying the heart fungus.
source_quote: I felt a little bad, in the way you feel bad about something you'd do exactly the same way again.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*One turn is a long time when you have nothing to do in it.*' as his reflection on waiting out the frightened condition.
source_quote: One turn is a long time when you have nothing to do in it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*The entertainment of watching enemies tear at each other is free.*' as his justification for initially observing the fight.
source_quote: The entertainment of watching enemies tear at each other is free.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*I'm a monk.*' as his final, resigned response to being reminded that his entire contribution required contact with the thing he was supposed to destroy.
source_quote: 'I'm a monk.' This came out in response to someone noting — correctly, irritatingly — that his entire contribution to a fight was predicated on being in contact with the thing he was supposed to be destroying.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*I have never once received a divine message that said wait this one out, it's interesting.*' as his justification for acting instead of observing.
source_quote: I have never once received a divine message that said *wait this one out, it's interesting.*

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*It was still humiliating.*' as his internal reflection on accepting the frightened condition.
source_quote: It was still humiliating.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, '*I stopped tallying.*' as his reflection on realizing he was chasing the fight across the map without control.
source_quote: I stopped tallying.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*The fear dropped into him like a stone into still water.*' as his description of the psychological impact of Ilvara’s gaze.
source_quote: The fear dropped into him like a stone into still water.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*I believe I should find out who that is before she finds out who we are.*' as his strategic resolve after the T'sarran warrior’s parting words.
source_quote: I believe I should find out who that is before she finds out who we are.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*No noise, just depth.*' as his description of the psychological impact of Ilvara’s gaze.
source_quote: No noise, just depth.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, '*The Underdark has a way of correcting your optimism before you even finish the equation.*' as his reflection on the cost of victory.
source_quote: The Underdark has a way of correcting your optimism before you even finish the equation.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*She said it in the tone of someone who genuinely believed it, which was the worst kind.*' as his reflection on Ilvara’s prophecies.
source_quote: She said it in the tone of someone who genuinely believed it, which was the worst kind.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*She was already something other than the woman she had been.*' as his description of Ilvara’s corruption.
source_quote: She was already something other than the woman she had been.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*I shall punch the mage.*' as his internal monologue before teleporting to kill the T'sarran mage.
source_quote: *I shall punch the mage.* Zalthir said this without particular enthusiasm.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*The fear cleared at the end of his turn, the way it had been promised to.*' as his observation after the frightened condition ended.
source_quote: The fear cleared at the end of his turn, the way it had been promised to.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*I have seen enough corrupted things in this Underdark — the egg, the grove, the Pudding King's kingdom of rot — to know what it looks like when something has been claimed entirely by a power it should never have touched.*' as his justification for delivering the killing blow.
source_quote: I have seen enough corrupted things in this Underdark — the egg, the grove, the Pudding King's kingdom of rot — to know what it looks like when something has been claimed entirely by a power it should never have touched.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, '*Dawnbringer pulsed once, steady warmth against my palm.*' as his final sensory detail after the battle.
source_quote: Dawnbringer pulsed once, steady warmth against my palm.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*He didn't fight the condition. He didn't look for angles.*' as his description of his own disciplined acceptance of fear.
source_quote: He didn't fight the condition. He didn't look for angles.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*The fight was contracting toward its end the way fights do, the radius shrinking as each threat resolved.*' as his observation of the battle’s conclusion.
source_quote: The fight was contracting toward its end the way fights do, the radius shrinking as each threat resolved.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*I watched from across the cavern and could not move toward her and filed it away and waited.*' as his final action before the fight ended.
source_quote: He watched from across the cavern and could not move toward her and filed it away and waited.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*I took note of that too.*' as his reflection on the T'sarran warrior’s threat.
source_quote: I took note of that too.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, '*I was mostly running.*' as his honest accounting of his role in the battle.
source_quote: The honest accounting of the rest of the battle: I was running.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*The distance between him and Ilvara was not fifteen feet.*' as his realization that his Eldritch Claw Tattoo’s reach was irrelevant.
source_quote: The distance between him and Ilvara was not fifteen feet.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*I have seen enough of this Underdark to know better than to dismiss it.*' as his justification for attacking Ilvara despite her seeming madness.
source_quote: I have seen enough of this Underdark to know better than to dismiss it.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*I'm a monk.*' as his final, resigned statement about his inability to act without contact.
source_quote: 'I'm a monk.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, '*I stopped tallying.*' as his realization that he was chasing the fight without control.
source_quote: I stopped tallying.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, '*I had delivered it with the emotional register of someone pushing a chair under a table.*' as his description of his own detachment.
source_quote: He had delivered it with the emotional register of someone pushing a chair under a table.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, '*I think I'm still going to go ahead and attack them.*' as his decision to act despite being entertained by the conflict.
source_quote: I think I'm still going to go ahead and attack them.
